label: Every first mover moved by none is PURE_ACT_5, with no potency, by Hypothetical-syllogism
meaning: Let t be a time and f a first mover moved by none at t. Then f moves something at t, and by the bridge f is moved in no respect at any time. So the In Metaph. IX, lect. 8 n. 11 reading applies to f at t: f is in potency in no respect at t.
